Shubman Gill tops ODI batting rankings, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi climbs T20I list

Shubman Gill has reclaimed the No. 1 position in the ICC Men's ODI batsman rankings. Simultaneously, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi has made a significant jump in the T20I batting rankings, moving up 230 places to enter the top 50. These rankings reflect recent performances in international cricket.
